reviewItem.question: If an exposed environment does nothing about "TCP LoadBalancer `terminationDelay` option: The TCP LoadBalancer `terminationDelay` option has been removed", what happens, and is that review or action? proposed: setting-ignored

consequence.statement: The terminationDelay field on IngressRouteTCP services will be ignored; the configuration must be moved to the corresponding TCPServersTransport resource.
consequence.remediation: Migrate terminationDelay configuration from IngressRouteTCP spec.routes[].services[].terminationDelay to the referenced TCPServersTransport spec.terminationDelay.

proposed.statement: The TCP LoadBalancer terminationDelay option has been removed from IngressRouteTCP service configuration and must now be configured on TCPServersTransport instead.
